parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet by opening and closing.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular and hinged to the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed around a hinge axis.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: An upper cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular and smooth-surfaced.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the upper storage area.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A matching cabinet door made of MDF, part of the front enclosure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides closure and aesthetic uniformity to the cabinet front.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, forming the outer box.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including doors and shelves, providing rigidity and shape.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf panel made of particle board, fitted inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet interior into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable vertically.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of particle board, rectangular and flat.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary or can be repositioned vertically.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf made of particle board, flat and rectangular.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the upper section of the cabinet for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable depending on design.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A top shelf made of particle board, forming the uppermost internal surface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed at the top section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.
